title: Sale of Alignment Services & Plans — Vehicle Eligibility, Term End and Ticket Posting
content:
### Sale terms for Alignment Services & Plans

1. **Eligible vehicle.** An alignment service or plan is sold for one vehicle whose class is in the line's list of eligible vehicle classes.
2. **Commercial use.** A plan whose line may not be sold for or used on a vehicle in commercial use is never sold for a vehicle in commercial use. A vehicle is in commercial use when its usage class is commercial, or when its latest entry on a Crestline Fleet Account roster is an enrollment of the vehicle on the fleet.
3. **Purchase price — no longer in force.** The clause that set the purchase price at the line's plan price less the line's tire bundle discount when a Crestline tire set had been installed on the same vehicle within the tire bundle window before the purchase date (that date itself included), and at the plan price otherwise — the bundle discount never combined with a fleet discount, and a fleet account's discount applying on a fleet-charged ticket only where the line allows it — is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current pricing basis.
4. **Expiration date.** The expiration date is the purchase date plus the line's term in months, counted as calendar months to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. Lifetime plans have no expiration date.
5. **Ticket posting.** The plan is a line on a store ticket, often the tire ticket. When that ticket is paid with the Crestline Credit Card or charged to a Crestline Fleet Account, the ticket total posts once, as one card purchase or one fleet invoice per service category.
6. **First alignment — no longer in force.** The clause that the first alignment is performed on the purchase visit as an included alignment is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

### Expiration dates worked through (hypothetical purchase dates)

| Purchase date | Term | Expiration date |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 12 months | 10 March of the following year |
| 31 August | 6 months | the last day of February (no 31 February exists) |
| any date | lifetime line | none |

superseded_clauses: purchase_price is plan_price minus tire_bundle_discount when alignment_msr_tire_bundle is true, and plan_price otherwise; the bundle discount is never combined with a fleet discount, and when the ticket is charged to a fleet account the fleet discount applies only where fleet_discount_applicable is true.
The first alignment is performed on the purchase visit as an included alignment.
